page_title: MON 0-4 WER | B. Monchengladbach v Werder Bremen 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Matthias Jollenbeck has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
88' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:7.
83' Horst Steffen has decided to make a change. Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) replaces Marco Friedl.
83' Substitution. Cameron Puertas is replaced by Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen).

81' 0 - 4 Goal! Victor Boniface plays in Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:4.

79' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
79' B. Monchengladbach get a corner.
78' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle as Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
76' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
75' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Romano Schmid.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Samuel Mbangula.
74' Today's match ends for Fabio Cristian Chiarodia who will be replaced by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
74' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Giovanni Reyna.
74' 0 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Moritz Nicolas no chance!
74' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
73' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals. PENALTY to Werder Bremen! Great chance to score.
72' Crossbar! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
72' The attendance for today's match is 52000.
69' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players.
69' The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.

68' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!

68' Close! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
67' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Mio Backhaus comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' Horst Steffen prepares a substitution. Jens Stage is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) will replace Lukas Ullrich.
60' Here is a change. Robin Hack is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach).
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Philipp Sander.
58' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
57' The referee awards a corner and Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) goes over to take it.

56' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
54' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends it out of play.

54' Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall. The referee blows his whistle, B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
52' Matthias Jollenbeck blows the whistle, Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
52' 56:44 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

47' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
46' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matthias Jollenbeck saw the whole situation.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
44' Great teamplay by Werder Bremen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

39' An accurate cross into the centre of the box from Franck Honorat gives Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) a clear sight of goal, but he sends his headed effort narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
38' Matthias Jollenbeck shows the yellow card to Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) for a heavy challenge.

37' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
36' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) prepares to take a corner kick.

35' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. B. Monchengladbach win a corner.
34' Werder Bremen take a short corner kick.

34' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
31' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) will take the corner.

30' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner.
26' 0 - 2 Goal! Samuel Mbangula shows great vision to find Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
25' Poor challenge! Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for tripping and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle.
24' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mio Backhaus intercepts the ball.
21' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
21' A cross from Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
18' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' 0 - 1 Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) takes a lovely first touch and strikes the ball in off the inside of the right post! Totally unique.

13' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
12' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

10' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
9' Neat passing move from Werder Bremen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Mio Backhaus leaps to intercept the corner kick from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach).

5' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. B. Monchengladbach can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
3' The B. Monchengladbach players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The referee of today's match will be Matthias Jollenbeck.
